recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no further FHIR core work is needed for FHIR-22800 unless a future work-group decision changes Procedure/BiologicallyDerivedProduct transplant modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-22800 was Published/Persuasive for Patient Care and requested adding BiologicallyDerivedProduct as a Procedure usedReference target so transplant Procedures can connect the recipient Procedure to donor-derived transplant material.
initial_application: Commit a073f6090eb1f147ef53d047b9906196d52c103c, merged by PR #614 as 3e8d663ab8fb334c50df71246d6b8fa92973f1b1, changed the then-authoritative Procedure spreadsheet from Reference(Device|Medication|Substance) to Reference(Device|Medication|Substance|BiologicallyDerivedProduct).
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. The old Procedure spreadsheet was replaced by source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml in commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157, and the current R5/R6 element is Procedure.used as CodeableReference with Device, Medication, Substance, and BiologicallyDerivedProduct targets. Remaining usedReference mentions in fhir.ini are migration mappings. FHIR-31539 separately handled the ModelInfo CodeableReference shape and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml already preserves the requested BiologicallyDerivedProduct target on the active Procedure.used element.

related_jiras.note: Reconciled Procedure.used's CodeableReference shape in the active ModelInfo example and is already committed on the combined branch.
Surfaced in Procedure.used/BiologicallyDerivedProduct searches but concerns additional device/procedure parameters resolved through Observation guidance, not this transplant target.
